**YuE2 now warns about low memory and lets you decide whether to continue.**

- On macOS and Windows, you can install YuE2, choose a profile manually, and regenerate a song even when RAM or VRAM is below the recommended level. During generation, warnings appear in the WebUI and in `song_status`. You can cancel at any time. If the runtime cannot allocate memory, the job reports a memory error.
- Auto uses memory readings to choose among installed profiles within the wait budget. If none meets the memory recommendations, Auto tries the lightest installed profile that fits the budget. After a Q8_0 allocation failure, Auto can retry with Q4_0 if it is installed and fits the remaining budget.
- The six README editions now highlight songs with vocals and explain how to install the optional YuE2 runtime and check device readiness. The sample page adds English and Japanese vocal demos.
